deficiencies.description: The word 'since' establishes a causal relationship between a surgeon being able to feel the tumour and the terminology still being heard today, whereas the original text used 'where' merely to describe the context in which the terminology is encountered.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: And you'll hear this kind of terminology even now, where a surgeon can see just by holding or touching a tumor, whether or not it's movable or immovable.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: This terminology is still heard now, since a surgeon can tell just by holding or touching a tumour whether it is movable or immovable.
deficiencies.caseForHarm: A student reading the rewrite may believe the lecturer provided an explicit causal explanation for the historical terminology's survival rather than simply describing the clinical setting where it is used.
deficiencies.caseAgainstHarm: In colloquial speech, 'where' is frequently used to loosely explain or justify a preceding remark, so 'since' preserves the natural sense of the spoken explanation without distorting any medical facts.
